brief.zh: 检测器认两类东西，每类各有一张排名表。输出两类 AP 的平均（mAP）。
brief.en: The detector recognises two kinds of thing, each with its own ranking. Output the average of the two classes' APs (mAP).

after.zh: mAP 是每类 AP 的平均：少见的类和常见的类一样重要，检测器不能只把常见的类做好。论文里报的检测成绩几乎都是它。
after.en: mAP is the average of the per-class APs: a rare class counts as much as a common one, so a detector cannot just do well on the common classes. Almost every detection result reported in papers is this number.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="own-10-3"></part-ref>读按分数排好的对错、名次和标注数 G，输出 AP。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-10-3"></part-ref> in the tray reads right or wrong in score order, the ranks and the number labelled G, and outputs the AP.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：两类各有一张排名表，输出两类 AP 的平均。
t.en: Your task in this level: each of two classes has its own ranking; output the average of their APs.
